query: Which causal identification strategies (DiD variants, synthetic control, IV, RDD) best detect trade-provision effects on fishing effort, catches, and stock status in ex post and ex ante evaluations?

response.query: Which causal identification strategies (DiD variants, synthetic control, IV, RDD) best detect trade-provision effects on fishing effort, catches, and stock status in ex post and ex ante evaluations?
response.answer: Difference-in-Differences (DiD) and synthetic control best detect trade-provision effects on fishing effort and stock status; instrumental variables (IV) and regression discontinuity design (RDD) are also effective for ex post and ex ante evaluations.
